title: 1811 Prairie's stone gable at the 1888 plate's full width
items: The Ames house's stone gable at 1811 Prairie now spans the full width of its bay, as the 1888 Inland Architect plate shows. Its sloping edges run into the corner pinnacles, and its peak stands as high as the plate's.
Its great arch has the plate's deep, two-part moulded ring, and the small windows above and below it are spaced as the plate spaces them.
